notes.title: Steam Deck Verified!
notes.notes:
Sagebrush is now officially VERIFIED on the Steam Deck! Now you can enjoy anxiety-inducing, heartbreaking cult drama on the bus, on the toilet, or anywhere else you'd like to feel sad!

A new patch was just pushed to fix some very minor issues navigating the menus with a gamepad.

notes.title: Have You Played… Sagebrush?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

Sagebrush

is a first-person game that I suppose we would say is a walking simulator, where you explore an abandoned cult compound. John Walker (RIP in peace) played it back in 2018 and found it fascinating.

notes.title: Sagebrush 1.4 - Now localized for Europe and Russia
notes.notes:
Hey, it's been a while!

But I've got some big news. It's console launch week for Sagebrush, with the game hitting Playstation, Xbox, and Switch over the next few days. But as part of that launch, thanks to our partners at Ratalaika Games, we're able to bring several new localizations of Sagebrush to PC and Mac!

Check out Sagebrush in French, German, Spanish, and Russian, available now!

Patch 1.4 also include some other various bug fixes and optimizations.

notes.title: Sagebrush is a fascinating exploration of an abandoned cult
notes.notes:
Developer: Redact Games
Publisher: Redact Games

Release: Out now
On: Windows, Mac
From: Itch, Steam
Price: 5.19/$6.99/ 5.69

Dipping into my Itch.io backlog, I found a game released in September that we completely missed – Sagebrush. A walking-sim-cum-puzzle game in which you explore the abandoned site of a cult. Abandoned in the worst possible way. And while this could obviously be a topic rife with issues, it’s handled here remarkably sensitively, without any loss of emotional punch.

notes.title: Sagebrush 1.3 Released!
notes.notes:
Sagebrush 1.3 has been released. This patch is mostly about performance -- most players should see moderate improvements to frame rate.

[h1]OPTIMIZATIONS:[/h1]

- Changes to LOD settings and shadow resolution
- Fixed an issue with the map camera that was causing performance degradation.

[h1]BUG FIXES:[/h1]

- Fixed an issue with the School Tapedeck playing the incorrect subtitles.

[h1]GAMEPLAY CHANGES (may contain spoilers):[/h1]

- Lightened the box containing the generator key to make it more noticeable.

notes.title: Sagebrush 1.25 Released, includes new Achievements!
notes.notes:
A lot of the work on 1.25 is backend work prepping for potential future localization and as such it's invisible to the end user. No new localizations are available... yet!

As far as visible changes:

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Fixed geometry in community hall to remove z-fighting/flickering issues

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

- Added 8 new achievements!

- Altered chalkboard texture in school to reduce misleading information

notes.title: Sagebrush 1.22 Released
notes.notes:
Sagebrush 1.22 has been released with some minor bug fixes and slight tweaks to item locations/puzzles based on community feedback.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Flipped door texture on bunker doors so they open correctly
- Fixed some geometry that was out of place in the bunkers

[b]Gameplay (may contain spoilers)[/b]
- Moved the position of the flashlight batteries slightly
- Added wooden boards to the mine entrance to prevent players from getting stuck in the mines without the axe
- Added a compass rose to the map
- Reworded a note to use accurate cardinal directions based on the newly added compass rose

notes.title: Sagebrush 1.2 Released!
notes.notes:
Sagebrush has been updated to version 1.2, with a few bug fixes and changes based on community feedback.

[h1]Sagebrush 1.2 Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
-----

- fixed an issue that caused the game to freeze when exiting the control mapping screen

[b]Gameplay Changes (may contain spoilers)[/b]
-----

- mouse and joystick look can now be inverted in the control mapping screen
- slightly adjusted position of gate and farm shed key
- added a text pop up when attempting to use flashlight without batteries
